name: Jaymo's Kitchen
description: Cooking minigames (at Cooking for Blockheads' oven and kitchens, which this mod requires), cookware, corpses and butchering, a wearable quiver, horse gear and carts, and horse-powered mill machines. Includes the carts of NiftyCarts (MIT, by MennoMax, paul101 and jmb19905; see LICENSE_niftycarts) and the machines of Horse Power (LGPL-3.0, by Gory_Moon; see LICENSE_horsepower).
